entities.name: Aline Chrétien
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Aline Chrétien was a Canadian academic administrator who was the wife of Canada's 20th prime minister, Jean Chrétien. She previously worked as a secretary, payroll manager, and model. In her later life, she was a trained pianist with The Royal Conservatory of Music.
